name: Ducati Pantah 500 / 600
engine: 499 to 649 cc air-cooled belt-driven desmo V-twin, two carbs
intro: The first belt-cam Ducati twin. Two carbs, desmo heads and the engine family behind every later air-cooled Ducati.

H: Desmo valve service needs both opening and closing shims checked. Follow the interval in the manual; it is not a job to skip.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
